approvedDesignText:
Add repeatable, mutually exclusive `--field <name>` and `--field-id <id>` flags to `gh project item-list`. Reject either selector flag with every explicit structured/format-output form supported by this command: `--format json`, `--jq`, and `--template` (including valid combinations). The command has no `--json` flag. Add a realistic repeated-selector help example: `gh project item-list 1 --owner monalisa --field Status --field Priority`.

For normal table output, fetch items as today and resolve selectors from the field definitions embedded in that response. If selectors are present and those definitions have additional pages, fetch and append only continuation pages before resolution, never redundantly refetching the initial page. If any continuation request fails, return a useful contextual error (for example, that additional project fields could not be fetched) and render no table output. This provides complete field-definition resolution while avoiding an extra field-ID preflight whenever the initial response is sufficient.

Resolve names case-insensitively and IDs exactly. Unknown names report the supplied name plus sorted available names; unknown IDs report sorted `name (id)` candidates; ambiguous names report lexically sorted matching IDs and direct users to `--field-id`. All selector errors occur before rendering, even if no items match. Preserve selector order and append columns after Type, Title, Number, Repository, and ID; headers use canonical resolved names with CRLF, CR, and LF normalized to spaces.

For each selected column, match an item field value strictly by the selected field’s node ID, never by name or response position. Missing values and unknown field-value variants render empty cells. Render supported values as human-readable text: date/text/single-select directly; numbers in shortest compact decimal form with no forced trailing zeros; iteration and milestone titles; labels by label name, users by login, reviewers by user login or team name, and pull requests by URL, each multi-value form joined with `, `; repository as its URL. Normalize CRLF, CR, and LF in every rendered value to spaces.

Add tests for parsing, mutual exclusion, each explicit output-form rejection, the help example, deterministic selector failures, ID-based selected-value matching, selection order, normalization, empty and unknown values, exact multi-value rendering, all supported display types, field-definition pagination and its no-output failure behavior, and mocked request counts confirming no redundant first-page field preflight.
